talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.sea_scholar.0: A boat! I came out here to read the tides, and the tides keep me. Take this for your crossing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.sea_scholar.1: Mind the rocks. I'm a scholar; I chart the currents from this tower. A scroll, for the crossing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.sea_scholar.2: Nobody rows out this far. The stars are clearer over open water, you know. Have this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.sea_retreat.0: You found my island. I left the courts for the sound of the sea. Take this, and don't tell the kings.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.sea_retreat.1: A guest, all the way out here? I came to get away from kingdoms. A scroll, for the crossing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.sea_retreat.2: Quiet out here, isn't it? Only the gulls argue. That's why I stay. Something for your trouble.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.sea_warden.0: Careful on the landing. I keep the light on this rock, so ships find their way. Take this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.sea_warden.1: Welcome, sailor. I watch this water for the Deep Mother; she likes to know who passes. A scroll, for the crossing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.sea_warden.2: You came through the reef? Then you've earned this. I keep watch; you keep your keel off the rocks.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.sea_exile.0: I was a court wizard, once. Put ashore here and left. It's good to see a face. Have this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.sea_exile.1: The king sent me as far over the sea as a ship would go. You found me anyway. A scroll, for the crossing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.sea_exile.2: An exile's hospitality is mostly fish, but take this. I've plenty of time to write them.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_sea_: The tide turns here twice a day and never the same way twice, %1$s. Twelve years and I still can't say why.
My notes are all salt-stained. The books on the top shelf are the dry ones. Don't touch the bottom shelf.
The fish out here are bigger than anything you'll catch from the shore. I've measured. Repeatedly.
I came out for one season of study. The boat that brought me never came back for me. I've stopped minding.
Kings kept asking me to curse their neighbours' harbours. Out here no one asks me anything.
I grow what the wind lets me grow and catch the rest. It's a better life than the court's, %1$s.
A ship passes now and then. I wave. Sometimes they wave back.
The sea is never quiet, but it's never rude either. I prefer it to company. Present company excepted.
When the fog comes in I light the lamp and sing. Ships hear one or the other.
The Deep Mother keeps what she takes, mostly. I keep a tally of the ships that pass, so she knows who's owed.
There's a whirlpool off the east side when the water's deep and the moon is wrong. Give it room, %1$s.
I've seen blue fire on the mastheads of ships going by in a storm. It means she's watching. It doesn't burn.
They rowed me out, put me on the rocks and rowed home. I watched them all the way to the horizon.
The king thought the sea would finish me. The sea has been kinder than he ever was, %1$s.
I write letters I can't send and put them in bottles. Perhaps one reached you.
If you sail past the capital, don't mention me. Or do. Let him know I'm still here.
